cohort: The participants were 33,355 women with singleton pregnancies in a Japanese population.
finding: The study established gestational age-specific reference intervals for eight complete blood count parameters, demonstrating dynamic changes across pregnancy and significant influences of maternal BMI and age on these hematological values.
cross-section timing: early (<20 weeks), mid (20-29 weeks), and late (>=30 weeks) pregnancy
gest_age: Early (<20 weeks), Mid (20-29 weeks), and Late (>=30 weeks) pregnancy
